popupExpandToggleTip: Expand inner scrollable panels and iframes to the whole content instead of catching them as they are shown. Frames from other websites request an extra permission one single time.
optionsLead: Changes are saved automatically and are synchronised with your browser profile.
optionsExpandPermGranted: Permission granted – frames from other websites are expanded too.
optionsExpandPermMissing: Without the "read all websites" permission, frames from other websites are caught as they are shown. Panels and iframes from the same website always work.
optionsRedactPIIDesc: Searches through the text the page shows for e-mail addresses, telephone numbers, card numbers, personal identity numbers and API keys and lays a fully covering field over what was hit, in the saved image. Text that is drawn as pixels it cannot read – a canvas, an image, a PDF, a video frame. The recognition runs on your device; nothing is ever sent anywhere. Applies to captures of the whole page (document scrolling); the field is permanent, so examine the result yourself.
scrollclipFormatHint: GIF is played back everywhere. WebM is smaller and softer (it is recorded directly in your browser).
batchPermissionHint: Opening these pages requires a one-time permission the first time.
batchPermissionDeclined: The permission to open those pages was denied.
redactActsNone: The masking found nothing in the text it read and painted no blocks. Nothing is marked below.
redactActsUncoveredOne: 1 hit is not covered in this image.
redactActsUncoveredOther: 2 hits are not covered in this image.
reviewLimit: FullShot reads the text that a page exposes. It cannot see this image. Everything drawn as pixels – a canvas, an image, a PDF page, a video frame – was never read.
reviewNoMarks: No blocks are marked in the image below.
